ios.desc:
Screenfully is the fastest way to turn raw mobile screen recordings into polished app demos.

Record, import, edit, style, and export high-quality videos and screenshots in one mobile workflow, with no desktop tools required.

Built for developers, founders, creators, and product teams who need clean, professional app content fast.


FEATURES

Record or Import in Seconds
• Capture your screen with optional microphone audio
• Import videos directly from Photos
• Jump straight into editing from your library or recorder flow

Powerful Mobile Editor
• Precise trim controls with timeline ruler and live scrubbing
• Undo and redo support across major editing actions
• Smoother playback and timeline behavior for reliable edits
• Zoom controls with multiple motion styles (Default, Smooth, Snappy, Ease In, Ease Out)

Professional Templates & Styling
• Ready-made templates for fast, polished output
• Solid colors, gradients, image backgrounds, and wallpapers
• Device frames with expanded iPhone color options
• Blur and shadow controls for depth and focus

Screenshot Studio
• Create high-resolution screenshots for product pages, social posts, and docs
• Crop, adjust padding, corner radius, backgrounds, and frames
• Improved preview/export alignment for accurate final output

Export Built for Distribution
• Aspect ratios for vertical, horizontal, square, and more
• Resolution controls with HD export options
• Reliable export flow with dedicated result screens
• Save to Photos/Files and share to your social and work channels

Privacy-First & On-Device
• Processing stays on your device
• No account required
• No cloud upload needed
• Works offline


SCREENFULLY PRO

Unlock the full experience:
• All Pro templates
• All Pro device frames
• All Pro aspect ratios
• Custom color backgrounds
• Custom gradient backgrounds
• Custom image backgrounds
• Zoom controls
• 1080p, 2K and 4K exports
• 30, 50 and 60 FPS exports
• Remove watermark

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in App Store settings. Pricing may vary by region.


WHO IT’S FOR

Screenfully is built for people who work with mobile apps:
• Developers: feature demos, bug reports, release previews
• Founders: launches, updates, walkthroughs
• Product teams: onboarding and UI showcases
• Support teams: fast how-to guides
• Creators: tutorials, reviews, social content

show_hn.title: Show HN: Screenfully – mobile screen-recording and showcase tool for builders

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I’m Amir (solo dev) and I built Screenfully because I wanted an easier way to record and showcase my mobile apps without needing a Mac or desktop just to record my mobile phone screen beautifully.

• What it does: record your phone screen, apply templates, export video, share anywhere. So it’s like Screen Studio but on mobile for mobile screen recordings.

• Why: I constantly need to plug my phone to a Mac or desktop just to record my mobile app for demo which doesn’t make sense, recording your mobile phone for a demo but you need another device? What? — so I made everything mobile.

• Get for free: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/screenfully/id6754534534 + https://www.producthunt.com/products/screenfully?launch=screenfully-2

• Would love your feedback on UX, template library, export formats you use.

Thanks for checking it out let me know what you think.

– Amir
